items.title: Simon Carman's life before alleged murder of Thai teenager
items.description: Accused murderer Simon Peter Carman spent much of the past decade isolating himself from many of his friends and family in Australia. It's in his rented room in Thailand that local police allege a gruesome murder occurred.

items.title: A catfish used AI to impersonate Alicia, then her Instagram got banned
items.description: Alicia discovered a Facebook account had gained more than 500,000 followers by posting AI-generated images of her.

items.title: Government rejects all UN recommendations on LGBTQIA+ rights
items.description: The Albanese government has accepted the lowest number of recommendations made by the UN Human Rights Council in 20 years, with none protecting the LGBTQIA+ community.

items.title: Socceroos' World Cup ends in heartbreak, but path forward now clear
items.description: The Socceroos exited the World Cup in the cruellest possible manner, on penalties to Egypt. But the roots of the defeat could be found in the 120 minutes of play, which clearly showed where Australia must improve.

items.title: Are America's founding principles being challenged?
items.description: The United States is celebrating its 250th anniversary today. Let's take a closer look at the document that birthed the nation and where things stand now.

items.title: As thin crowds at Trump's fair go viral, Americans reflect on July 4
items.description: Donald Trump has been pushing a patriotic message ahead of a July 4 milestone, but some Americans say they feel no national pride at this point in their country's history.

items.title: Taylor Swift marries Travis Kelce as fans celebrate America's 'royal wedding'
items.description: An open-oven-door style heatwave in New York could not stop Taylor Swift's famously enthusiastic fans from showing up for what's been dubbed America's royal wedding.

items.title: How rugby league became Australia's most valuable football code
items.description: A $5 billion-plus broadcast rights deal is expected to be announced this week, making rugby league Australia's most valuable football code.

items.title: Live: Demons blitz Hawks early as Giants, Dockers meet in Canberra
items.description: Hawthorn hosts Melbourne in Tasmania as the GWS Giants take on a red-hot Fremantle side in Canberra. Follow live.

items.title: 'Towelling the bloke up in the cells': Shocking police emails revealed
items.description: Emails reveal an extraordinary exchange between AFP officers after an Indigenous man was allegedly beaten and illegally strip-searched at a Canberra watchhouse.

items.title: Third teenager charged with murder over Melbourne stabbing
items.description: The friends and family of Darweish Mohamed, who was allegedly stabbed to death outside a Craigieburn hospital on Wednesday night, will remember him at a memorial today while a third teen has been charged with his murder.

items.title: Prosperous NT mining town prepares for tough times as Rio Tinto exit looms
items.description: In Australia's tropical north, a mining town is preparing for the departure of its biggest employer, and locals are accusing the mining giant of squeezing out small businesses on its way out.

items.title: Robotic rescue mission underway to save space telescope falling to Earth
items.description: NASA launched a mission on Friday, local time, to try to prevent one of its aging telescopes from burning up in the atmosphere, a complicated operation expected to last months.

items.title: Trump made money off his meme coin, did its investors?
items.description: US President Donald Trump made huge amounts of money from his family's crypto and meme coin ventures last year, but did his investors?

items.title: As NAIDOC turns 50, what is 'deadly' and what does it mean to you?
items.description: As official NAIDOC celebrations get underway across the country, the ABC's Matt Francis asks what is deadly and what does it mean to the Indigenous community across the country.

items.title: Rethinking drinking as gen Z wakes up to joy of early rising
items.description: Pub nights are becoming far less rowdy as young people swap big nights out for morning run clubs.

items.title: Why Avalon Emerson refuses to stay in one lane
items.description: Avalon Emerson has built a global reputation as a DJ, but she soon found standing still was not for her.

items.title: When a fit young man disappears, he leaves behind a trail of strange clues
items.description: When the first major relationship of Jack McLennan's life implodes, he does what plenty of young men do: meets a mate for a quiet beer. But by morning, Jack's disappeared, leaving behind a series of mysterious clues and a devastated family.

items.title: Conroy's 'dead cat' reminds us Labor has tough calls ahead
items.description: After guiding the country through a tumultuous six months, the Albanese government faces tough fiscal and political decisions.

items.title: Australia's woeful Asian languages literacy is failing us

items.title: Four rescued from roof of stranded 4WD in flooded river

items.title: Live: Colombia grabs lead over Ghana as brutal opening sees two players injured
items.description: Colombia takes on Ghana in Kansas City for a spot in the Round of 16 as Argentina advances after an extra time win over Cabo Verde. Follow live.

items.title: Investors 'all but gone' from Melbourne property market after budget
items.description: With clearance rates in Melbourne sitting just above 50 per cent, experts say sluggish sales show investors have lost trust in bricks and mortar.

items.title: Hunter region to gain $12b train manufacturing hub
items.description: NSW Premier Chris Minns tells a conference of the party faithful that the state's next set of trains will be manufactured "where the original fleet was built".
